title: Saudi Arabia’s Oil ‘Lifeline’ Was Attacked. Here’s What to Know.
summary: A drone attack from Iraq forced Saudi Arabia to close its East-West pipeline, the kingdom said, threatening a key workaround to Iran’s Persian Gulf blockade.
